list.select_or_create: Select a file from the list or create a new one
cron.help: View of the crontab for the account running the panel. All lines are shown, including comments and variables. New jobs are appended at the end.
cron.readonly_note: Existing lines cannot be edited or deleted from the panel - use `crontab -e` for that. The panel only appends, so it can never overwrite anything.
hooks.help: Hooks run automatically by Claude Code. Read from settings.json and settings.local.json.
hooks.readonly_note: Read-only view. The panel does not write hooks, because settings.json is a live Claude Code config file - a faulty write would break a working environment. Use an editor to make changes.
